gramm cheat sheet

Every method of gramm with its options, defaults and accepted values. A gramm figure is built in steps:

  1. g = gramm(…)data and groups
  2. facet_grid()subplots
  3. geom_ / stat_layers
  4. set_ optionsappearance
  5. draw()the figure
  6. update()more layers
  7. export()to a file

Layers: raw data, statistics and reference lines and shapes. Steps 2 to 4 can come in any order.
